title: Omit new generated artifacts from publication instead of blocking it
origin: M2-PILOT live run: validation created __pycache__/*.pyc (excluded_generated, added); publication_snapshot and the publisher refused with rejected_paths, so no Python session that runs tests could publish.
write_scope: repoask/publication/service.py (_snapshot rejected check, preview omitted_paths, default PR body)
acceptance: Only reason excluded_generated with status added is omitted; any other reason, or a generated-pattern path with status modified/deleted, still fails with rejected_paths
Omitted paths are never uploaded or included in the tree; snapshot returns them as `omitted` (paths only), preview as `omitted_paths`, default PR body lists them
outcome rejected_paths / publication_eligible (automatic policy) count only blocking rejections
Hash/consistency checks between checkpoint, patch and stats still hold with omitted entries
Focused tests for each rule, plus the combined test in tests/test_publication_integration.py extended with a session whose validation produced __pycache__ files publishing one draft PR without them
reviewer: fresh Claude quality-reviewer with boundary checks (opposite harness)
